beats.en: Adolescents face stress from high expectations, causing physiological (heart rate, blood pressure) and psychological (attention, emotion) changes. Since stress cannot be avoided, it must be managed. Yoga as a way of life
beats.speakEn: Adolescents face stress from high expectations, causing physiological (heart rate, blood pressure) and psychological (attention, emotion) changes. Since stress cannot be avoided, it must be managed. Yoga as a way of life

beats.en: We cannot eliminate all stress, so managing stress through yoga is essential.
